notes: This is the only file to edit when a project gains or loses a public site, picture, or description. Put the repo name under repos and list absolute https URLs in sites. A site can be a URL string or {url, label}.

npm run build fetches public GitHub repos, skips forks, templates, and empty repos, then requests every URL below. A URL is linked only when that request shows a live site. Dead hosts, Vercel payment pages, Base44 missing apps, Cloudflare error 1000, and Cloudflare Access login walls are left off the card.

image is the front picture and backImage is the back picture, both under public/projects. Live-site screenshots were taken with headless Chrome. A card with no backImage draws generated circuit art on its back.
extras are cards for projects that have no public GitHub repo. Give them a repoName slug, title, language, updated, description, sites, image, and backImage. An empty link hides the GitHub button.

roll10000.com currently answers with a Cloudflare Access login page and online.roll10000.com answers 404, so the verifier leaves them off. www.roll10000.com serves the game. They link automatically once they answer without a login.
lillysapp.com answers with Cloudflare error 1000, so lilly-s-appYNK222 has no sites entry.
youneekcare.com does not resolve, so the youneek repo has no sites entry.

forge.youneek.xyz and w.youneek.xyz currently serve this portfolio instead of their own Workers, so Real-Neural-Forge links the workers.dev forecast and Death Terminal links its landing page at terminal.youneek.dev, which has downloads and install commands for Windows, macOS, and Linux (the Windows zip comes from the dt-windows-download Worker).
The Architects GM (the-architects-gm) is an owner desk, not a public project, so it has no card.

apex-controlYNK222 (Apex Control) and atc222trainer (ATC222 Trainer) are extra ATC games. They stay in skipRepos so a later sync leaves them off even if the public API lists them again. YNKAIRTRAFFICGAME and unique-sky (YouNeeK Stars) stay on the site.
Do not add relay.youneek.xyz. That hostname is the youneek-share-relay Worker.

10000TheFinalBoss.title: 10,000 The Final Boss
10000TheFinalBoss.description: YouNeeK 10,000, a dice game with local multiplayer, story mode, a shop, and progression. Runs entirely in the browser with no account or backend.

3i-atlas-the-gameYNK.title: 3i-Atlas
3i-atlas-the-gameYNK.description: A stealth strategy game. You are interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS and must keep your comet disguise intact across eight stages while observatories watch. Easy, Medium, and Hard modes.

used-artifacts.title: Used Artifacts
used-artifacts.description: A marketplace for buying and selling used artifacts, with ID-verified sellers, signed provenance statements, payment held until delivery, and the Beta Founder badge program. The live site is coming soon.

YouNeeKTimeTheFinalBoss.title: YouNeeK Time
YouNeeKTimeTheFinalBoss.description: A dark, minimal clock for the web with a custom clock face, hourly sound, and a live moon phase. Has an Apple Watch app. Runs fully in the browser.

youneekproradarBABY.title: YouNeeK Pro Radar
youneekproradarBABY.description: Military-style NEXRAD radar and severe-weather tracker: live radar mosaics, NWS alert overlays, NOAA weather radio, and a one-tap shelter SMS to your contacts.

Real-Neural-Forge.title: Real Neural Forge
Real-Neural-Forge.description: A transformer pipeline for time-series prediction built with PyTorch, CUDA, and FastAPI, with a REST API for predictions and training and a forecast dashboard.

Death-terminal-.title: YouNeeK Death Terminal
Death-terminal-.description: A brutalist, GPU-accelerated terminal with AI command suggestions, Vulkan rendering, SSH, and Lua config. The card links the landing page, with downloads and install commands for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

youneek.xyz.title: youneek.xyz
youneek.xyz.description: This portfolio. A cyberpunk page with one card per public GitHub repo. A card shows a site link only after the URL answers; otherwise it shows TV static.

lilly-s-appYNK222.title: Lilly's App
lilly-s-appYNK222.description: A family chore and rewards app built with React, Vite, and Supabase. Parents create chores, approve submissions, and manage allowances.

youneek.title: YouNeeK Care
youneek.description: Landing page for the YouNeeK crypto token: mission, transparency, impact, roadmap, a swap widget, staking, donations, and a how-to-buy guide.

youneek-time.title: YouNeeK Time (earlier)
youneek-time.description: Earlier YouNeeK Time build: a dark, minimal world clock with a widget mode and display settings. The live site is YouNeeK Time.

youneek-pro-radar.title: YouNeeK Pro Radar (earlier)
youneek-pro-radar.description: Earlier copy of Pro Radar: NEXRAD radar mosaics, NWS alert overlays, NOAA weather radio, and a shelter SMS button. The live site is YouNeeK Pro Radar.

youneek-pro-radarYNK222.title: YouNeeK Pro Radar (YNK222)
youneek-pro-radarYNK222.description: The Pro Radar weather app on its own: radar, a 3D globe, forecasts, lightning, hurricanes, wildfires, NOAA radio, and emergency SMS drafts.

YouNeeK-Dashboard.title: YouNeeK Dashboard
YouNeeK-Dashboard.description: Personal Vite + React + TypeScript dashboard that reads repo counts, language mix, and push activity from the GitHub API and lists YouNeeK products.

YNKAIRTRAFFICGAME.title: Air Traffic Controller
YNKAIRTRAFFICGAME.description: A browser air traffic control game with a live radar scanner, drone detection, voice commands, a watchlist, incidents, and analytics. Data stays in your browser.

youneek-satellite-tracker.title: YouNeeK Satellite Tracker
youneek-satellite-tracker.description: Live 3D globe of satellite positions from CelesTrak orbital data: Starlink, the ISS, GPS, and more, with time simulation, search, and an AR mode.

remnant.title: REMNANT
remnant.description: A 1947 stealth game. You are a crashed mind that inhabits machines such as crates, radios, and a jeep battery, dodging flashlight cones to transmit a signal before dawn.

Cloudripper.title: YouNeeK CloudRipper
Cloudripper.description: One CLI for cloud waste, real spend, and safe chaos tests across AWS, GCP, and Azure. Inventories resources, reads actual spend, applies confirmed cost actions, and scales instance groups.

Calculator-.title: Calculator
Calculator-.description: Savage Calculator: a React calculator with scientific functions, mathjs expression parsing, live preview, and a history you can reuse with Ans.

unique-sky.title: Unique Sky
unique-sky.description: YouneeK Stars, an AR star-naming app: pan the night sky, claim stars with symbolic ownership, do daily sky hunts, and browse a star map with a leaderboard.

Project-Alpha.title: Project Alpha
Project-Alpha.description: A self-hosted real-time full-stack starter: React + Vite client, Node/Express API, Redis, and Server-Sent Events, run together with Docker Compose.

CryptoVault.title: CryptoVault
CryptoVault.description: A browser dashboard for tracking crypto holdings: total value, 24h gain or loss, and an add-asset form. The repo also has a Rust wasm-bindgen library.

bison-earth-plum-bird.title: Bison Earth
bison-earth-plum-bird.description: An app-builder workspace (Vite, server code, auth, database migrations) that contains the INHABIT game from REMNANT. No README.

multitent.title: Multitent
multitent.description: A Cloudflare Worker that creates a Workers for Platforms dispatch namespace, deploys Workers into it, and routes each one under its own path.

youneekvibecode.title: YouNeeK Vibe Code
youneekvibecode.description: YouNeeK fork of Cloudflare VibeSDK, an open-source platform where an AI agent builds and deploys full-stack apps on Cloudflare.

extras.title: YouNeeK Calendar
extras.description: A calendar with a month grid, moon phases, a list of new and full moons, a Roman March-first month order toggle, and a birthday panel with astrology reference tables.

extras.title: The Architects
extras.description: A satirical strategy game built in Godot. You run a fictional shadow faction through human vessels from 2031 to the horizon, keeping Belief high and Heat low.
